title: EV busbar temperature at 400 A
line: Current flow and temperature in a six-bolt copper module busbar at 400 A in still air, against an 85 C limit.
description: A 200 x 30 x 2 mm Cu-ETP busbar collects six cells on M8 bolts and hands 400 A to an M10 output bolt. The study solves current flow and temperature together, with copper's resistivity rising with temperature, in still air at 25 C, and reports the peak temperature against an 85 C limit. The busbar is a parametric RunMat MCAD part.
thumbnailAlt: Temperature of a six-bolt copper busbar carrying 400 A, hottest just before the output bolt, solved in RunMat
